Retrieve the stolen purse from the thieving nanny.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}

===Objectives===
*Search [[Haiju Lagoon]] for [[Paomu]]'s missing nanny and locate Paomu's missing coin purse.
*Defeat the [[Ravenous Drake|ravenous drake]].
*Return Paomu's coin purse.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 150 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
To acquire the quest, head northwest from [[Zen Daijun (outpost)|Zen Daijun]] toward the green star shown on the map. Then head to [[Haiju Lagoon (landmark)|Haiju Lagoon]] and go to its northwestern end. There you will find a Ravenous Drake. Kill it and use the [[Bleached Bones]] there to get the purse. Return the purse to Paomu.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Dragon]]s
*{{n}} 11 (24) [[Ravenous Drake]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Paomu'''
:''"You are a <[[character]] name>, {{sic|Presumably this should refer to the character's profession instead?}} are you not? Please, you must help me! I do not have much money, but my son is ill. I hired a woman named '''Mara''' to help me look after him, but when I woke up this morning, '''Mara''' was gone...and what is worse, so is my coin purse! I should have never trusted a stranger, and I cannot leave [[Nei]] alone here. Can you help me? Just find '''Mara''' and retrieve my '''coin purse'''. Please, I know not where else I should turn!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = How despicable!  Of course I will help you.
| decline = Forget it; you've obviously learned nothing about trusting strangers.
| ask = Please, keep looking for '''Mara'''. I know that she must be out there somewhere, spending all the gold in my '''coin purse'''...
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''[[Nei]]'''
:''"I think I know where Mara is, but mother is so upset, she will not believe me.  Mara did take the coin purse, but only to place a bet on the drake races they hold on that little island to the north.  Mara said that my mother would never approve, but she was sure she could win enough to pay for my medicine for years!  Funny, though, I have never actually seen anyone racing drakes up there...or anywhere, really."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Paomu'''
:''"Oh no...this is the right coin purse, but it is torn, empty, and covered in...is that blood? How will I pay for Nei's medicine now? But I'm sure you did all you could, <character name>, and at least that thieving Mara learned her lesson."''
